thesis: The release-watch is useful as a drift detector because the recorded release is dated 2025-01-23 and the checked 30-day window shows no commits, but whether the project is still shipping remains unknown rather than proven inactive.

risks: The repository says the contracts are in early stages and were released as draft code for public building and feedback.
Which hook callbacks execute on a pool cannot change after pool initialization, limiting later changes to that pool.
The checked window shows no real work, raising an open question about ongoing shipping activity.
The README text provided is truncated before the full local deployment and usage section, so full integration instructions could not be confirmed from the pages read.
unknowns: Whether Uniswap/v4-core is still shipping: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.
The Uniswap/v4-core repository page shows 1,518 Commits.: Its source holds no passage that says this.
Whether Uniswap/v4-core is still shipping.: Evidence of real-work commits after the checked 30-day window, or a newer release tag and date than v4.0.0 on 2025-01-23.

Whether the Hugging Face dataset hivepunk-632-4934c76e/uniswap-v4-core-release-watch has been published with labelled FACT/DERIVED/UNKNOWN rows.: A readable page showing that dataset repository, its README.md and its data files.
wouldChangeMind: Finding newer real-work commits or a newer release tag after v4.0.0 would change the inactivity picture.
Finding the published dataset page with its source URLs would confirm the tool's public output.
Finding a full, untruncated README or repository documentation would clarify integration and deployment risks.
